status: FROZEN 2026-10-04 by author approval, before any E-session label was read by the revision pipeline; epoch-selection mode member1; amendment 1 applied 2026-10-04 before any E label was read

data.dataset: BCI Competition IV 2a, 9 subjects, 22 EEG channels, 4 classes
data.artifact_rule: trials containing event 1023 excluded (T and E)
data.cleaning: EOG OLS regression over whole session (unsupervised), 50 Hz notch, common average reference; units microvolts

split.ensemble: arithmetic mean of member class probabilities (decoder) and of member GMM posteriors

epoch_selection.alternative_full: each member selects its own epoch (not used unless stated)
epoch_selection.rule_v1: train on A_fit of member 1, choose the epoch with minimum A_val NLL (earliest on ties) after a 5-epoch moving average; all 5 members are then trained on their full A_j for that number of epochs with the same schedule

vit.architecture: ChannelViT as in the original paper: timm vit_tiny, depth 6, 8 heads, embed 192, patch 16 on a 33x64 STFT map per channel (2x4 tokens per channel), shared across channels, mean channel pooling
vit.input: per-trial: db4 wavelet soft-threshold denoising, 8-30 Hz band-pass (4th-order Butterworth, zero phase), STFT hann nperseg 64 / noverlap 48 / nfft 64 on 0-4 s; magnitude in microvolts; log1p; per-(channel,freq,time) z-score with A_j statistics
vit.optimizer: AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 0.05, cosine schedule over the selected epochs, batch 32
vit.augmentation: as original (Gaussian noise 0.12, time/frequency masks, channel drop 0.12, time shift, scale) on training batches only

fbcsp.csp: one-vs-rest, 4 components (2 pairs) per class and band, OAS-regularized, log-variance
fbcsp.selection: MIBIF, k = 16 fixed a priori, fitted on A_j

eegnet.architecture: EEGNet-8,2 (Lawhern et al. 2018), dropout 0.5, kernel 64, native softmax head
eegnet.input: 0.5-4.0 s, 4-38 Hz band-pass, per-channel z-score with A_j statistics
eegnet.embedding_for_gmm: flattened output of the last separable-conv block

heads.concat_lr: StandardScaler + multinomial LogisticRegression(C = 1, lbfgs, max_iter 2000) on [MIBIF-FBCSP features, ViT 192-d embedding], fitted on B_j
heads.gmm: StandardScaler + PCA(d = min(8, n_B - 1)) + per-class GaussianMixture(M = 1, diag, reg_covar 1e-3), equal class priors from B_j counts, fitted on B_j embeddings of the same member

scores.aligned_gmm: p_G(y = yhat_F | x), p_G = member-mean GMM posterior, yhat_F = argmax of member-mean decoder probability

temperature.search: bounded scalar minimisation on [0.25, 4]; fallback T = 1 on failure

thresholds.rule: per subject and score: sort C scores descending, threshold = score at rank ceil(q * n_C); accept if score >= threshold; ties accepted

evaluation.aurc: AURC = (1/N) sum_k risk_k over the E trials of one subject sorted by score; ties in score broken by a fixed label-free hash of trial_id
evaluation.aggregation: per subject, then unweighted mean over 9 subjects
evaluation.calibration: 8 equal-width bins on [0,1], top-label ECE/MCE, NLL, multiclass Brier

statistics.primary: two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-subject AURC(aligned_gmm) - AURC(msp), main decoder

families_holm.A: main decoder: aligned_gmm vs ts_msp, neg_entropy, ts_neg_entropy, max_gmm (AURC)
families_holm.B: q = 0.8, aligned_gmm and ts_msp: accepted vs full accuracy, kappa; gain over random rejection
families_holm.D: perturbations: aligned_gmm vs ts_msp AURC at the highest level of each perturbation

statistics.ci: subject bootstrap of the mean and median paired difference, 10000 resamples, seed 2026, percentile

perturbations.applied_to: cleaned E epochs (microvolts) before every model-specific transform; models, temperatures and thresholds unchanged

channel_dropout.order: fixed random channel permutation per subject, seed 7

eog_mixing.source: EOG segments from the E-session eye-movement block (event 1072), propagated with beta estimated on that block; random segment start per trial, seed 11

amendments.reason: For A02 the EEGNet validation NLL (run 5, ~46 trials) increased monotonically from epoch 1 while validation accuracy rose from 0.15 to 0.48, so the v1 rule selected 1 epoch (an essentially untrained network).
amendments.change: epoch_selection.rule replaced by: minimum 5-epoch moving-average validation NLL over epochs >= 10; if that value is not lower than the epoch-1 value, use the epoch maximising 5-epoch moving-average validation accuracy (earliest on ties). Applies to ChannelViT and EEGNet, all subjects. v1 selections are kept in models/<S>/epochs.json (*_v1).
amendments.consequence: A01 members trained under v1 were archived (models_v1_archive/, out/raw_v1_archive/) and retrained; no evaluation-session labels had been read.
